programs.description: Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
Passenger
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
An unexpected event on the day of their granddaughter's engagement leads a nonagenarian couple on a journey that tests their familial bonds.
Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.
Kumaran and Lakshmi, hailing from varying social backgrounds, get romantically involved, defying societal norms. Later, Lakshmi's father attempts to sever their relationship.
Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.
Devan, an orphan, drinks an invisibility potion and sets out to rescue Maya, a journalist who is raising him, after she is kidnapped by an influential man.
Vindhyan often reminisces about his childhood infatuation with Neelima who now resides in America. However, to his discontent, she is in love with another man, Shivpal.
Bringing the best in cinema.

Nandagopal discovers that his late father owned a bungalow in Tamil Nadu and tries to sell the property due to financial issues. However, Nachiappa, who is already staying there, refuses to vacate it.
Daniel's grandfather, who is a strict patriarch, has the final say in every decision involving his family. However, things take a turn when he decides to make Daniel a priest.
Two friends buckle under the pressure of supporting their families and marrying off their sisters. Despite their endless struggles, they provide a good quality of life to their families.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
When her father's business suffers tremendous losses, Soorya, a determined girl, decides to step up to support her family.
Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.
After a lottery ticket salesman learns that one of his customers has won INR five crores, he tries to get back the ticket. Unfortunately, he finds the customer dead and has to lie to protect himself.
